itemList.description:
POWER TRANSFORMERS
31.5 MVA,66/11 kV class, 3Ph, 50Hz, Core Type, 2 winding Delta / Star, Vector Group Dyn11, OLTC, ONAN/ONAF with Fan control cubicle RTCC Panel, Numerical RTCC Panel with optic fibre temperature sensor, first filling of oil and 10 percentage spare oil in non-returnable drums, etc., complete with terminal connector suitable for Drake ACSR on primary side of transformer and copper flat on 11kV and neutral side as per technical specification. 
Note Copper Flats required for Power Transformers shall be supplied along with the Transformers as per Technical Specifications.

FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENTS
Supply,Erection, Testing & Commissioning of Nitrogen Injection fire extinguishing system as per the recommendation of the supplier of the fire fighting system for Power Transformer below 100MVA as per technical specifications.

CURRENT TRANSFORMER : Current transformer Single phase, oil filled outdoor type with rigid bimetallic terminal connectors suitable for Aluminium Rigid Bus/ Drake ACSR conductor as required, as per Technical Specicification.
i)66kV Class, 40kA,  CT of ratio  400-200/1-1-1A 
For metering : Accuracy 0.2S, Burden 10 VA
For backup protection : Accuracy 5P20. Burden 30 VA
For differential /Distance protection PS class, Vk=1600V & Rct. 4ohm at 400/1A, Vk=800V & Rct. 2Ohm at 200/1A

ii) 11 kV Class, 31.5kA, NCT of ratio 2000-1200/1-1-1A for REFR protection
NOTE
1) For details refer APPENDIX-3  Technical Parameters of current Transformers for type and rating in Section -Instrument Transformer Technical Specfication.
2) All the current transformer in each kV Class shall be of One and the same make for interchangeability and relability of performance.
3) The make & characteristic of 11kV NCT should be the same as that of the Incomer CT of 11kV switchgear

Total Weight of Station Structure & Mounting Structures fabricated out of Galvanised Mild Steel (excluding Bolts & nuts) as per Technical Specification refer Techno-commercial sheets for break up of quantities
Total Weight of supply of Bolts & nuts of Mounting Structures as per Technical Specification.

1.1kV class PVC insulated copper control cables of following sizes with Lugs/Ferrules/Gland as per technical specifications:
i) 19 Core 2.5 Sq.mm.
ii) 4 Core 6.0 Sq.mm.
iii) 10 Core 2.5Sq.mm
iv) 4 Core 4.0 Sq.mm
v) 4 Core 2.5 Sq.mm
vi) Copper PVC Instrumentation Cable, Armoured(Screened twisted pair Cable) 1Px0.5Sq.mm
Vii)Copper PVC Instrumentation Cable, Armoured(Screened twisted pair Cable) 4Px0.5Sq.mm
viii) Copper PVC Instrumentation Cable, Armoured(Screened twisted pair Cable) 8Px0.5Sq.mm

11KV  U.G. Cable with the required cable terminations as per technical Specification:
a) 11kV XLPE cable, 1Cx1000Sq. mm. Aluminium cable  from 66/11kV transformer LV to 11kV Switchgear.
b) Heat shrinkable type Cable termination kits suitable for 1Cx 1000 Sq.mm XLPE cable (Indoor type)
c) Heat shrinkable type Cable termination kits suitable for 1Cx 1000 Sq.mm XLPE cable (Out door type)

Specifications, erection of the complete transformer(replacement of gaskets and miscellaneous itmes if any), wiring of transformer, testing & commissioning etc.

EARTH MAT FORMATION:
a) Grounding of equipment with 50 x 6 mm G.I. Flat and connecting equipment to the earthmat/ground pit. Each point of earthing with all formation works like bending, twisting, drilling of holes and connecting by welding (inclusive of all T&P and consumables) to the earthmat/ground pit/point of earth connection, all the materials supplied by the contractor.

b) Grounding of equipment with 75 x 6 mm G.I. Flat and connecting equipment to the earthmat/ ground pit. Each point of earthing with all formation works like bending, twisting, drilling of holes and connecting by welding (inclusive of all T&P and consumables) to the earthmat/ground pit/ point of earth connection, all the materials supplied by the contractor.

c) Grounding of equipment by providing cast iron pipe of 100 mm ID 13 mm thickness, 2.75 metre long with 2 part clamp out of G.I. Flat 50 X 6 mm continuously welded alround the pipe using cast iron welding electrodes as per drawing including the cost of excavation (All materials to be supplied by the contractor)
d) Supplying & fixing 450 mm dia 450 mm height 1.5 to 2 thick hume pipe collar (non ressure type) for earth pits including all lead and lifts etc..

1) DECOMMISSIONING 
a) Dismantling of 3x20 MVA, 66/11 kV, Transformer & parts like Radiators, Bushings draining of oil from Transformer, etc,.complete as per the direction of site Engineer(Work-A)
b)  Dismantling of 2x20 MVA, 66/11 kV, Transformer & parts like Radiators, Bushings draining of oil from Transformer, etc,.complete as per the direction of site Engineer(Work-B)
b) Moving of Transformer from the plinth to the loading point as per direction of site Engineer.

2) Releasing of Equipments:
a) Releasing of existing 11kV NCT
b) Releasing of 66kV CTs
Releasing of existing Cable Mounting Structure
3) a) b) Releasing and Re-erection of existing NCT/ Cable Mounting Structure
Demolishing cement concrete manually/ by mechanical means including disposal of material to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge.

Earth work excavation by manual means for drains, canals, waste weir, draft, approach channels, key trenches, foundation of Buildings & bridges and such simillar works in all kinds of soils, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter, excavated surface leveled and sides neatly dressed disposing off the excavated stuff or sorting & stacking the selected stuff for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools & other appurtenaces required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils Depth upto 1.5 m.

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. 
Mix 1:3:6 (M10) Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Foundation works. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticizers laid in finished layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing,  form work, centering & scaffolding  and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications.  
M25 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates -  (8% cosidered for Form work)

Steel Fabrication: Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification All other type of structures

Providing 20 mm cement plaster of mix :1:6 (1 cement: 6 fine sand) to brick/stone masonary including rounding off corners wherever required smooth rendering, providing and removing scaffolding, including cost of materials, labour, curing complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Providing and fixing Structural Steel work in single section, fixed with or without connecting plate, including cutting, hoisting, fixing in position and applying a priming coat of approved steel primer all complete including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.

Filling available excavated earth (excluding rock) in trenches, plinth, sides of foundations and other similar works etc. in layers not exceeding 20cm in depth, consolidating each deposited layer by ramming and watering, lead up to 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m.

Providing and fixing 3m long 25mm dia TMT dowel bars 1.5m inserted in 50mm dia holes drilled in hard rock and grouting in CM 1:1 including necessary bending, hooking, cutting and handling charges including cost of all materials, labour, HOM, form works, scaffolding & centering complete as per specifications. the cost of steel. (MORTH clause 1200). -do- below LWL in open foundation upto 3m.

Labour charges for shifting of structural steel  Mazdoor Heavy
Removal of Unserviceable Soil with Disposal upto a suitable distance as directed by the Engineer incharge of work

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete  for all Sub structures of building, Irrigation works, Sub structure works of bridges, Drain works  & other parallel works from 0.50m to 3.50 m height. The granite/trap/basalt  crushed graded coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers,  laid in layers, well compacted using needle  vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of  relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, form work, centering & scaffolding and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications.

Providing and laying of 1.5 mm thick SBS modified self adhesive single stick waterproofing membrane, with minimum elongation of 300%  and puncture resistance of  greater than 200 N (as per ASTM E154), with an overlap of 100mm on the side and 100mm in vertical lapping over a coat bituminuos primer @ 0.25 l/m2, complete including surface preparation as per the methodology and site condition & placing the dimple board over the SBS membrane.  The cost is inclusive of surface preparation, crack filling, repair of loose mortar etc. completely as per specification.
